Read all six inputs/actions, runtime traces, initial images and independent reference.
Inspected action checkpoints and large-font scroll screenshots; compared native row/control states.
Confirmed RTL visual reversal and disabled appearance with crops and pixel observations; checked source causes.

workflow: Assigned native-ui-agent protocol applied to supplied frozen native evidence. No capture command was rerun and no production sources were edited.

findings.description: In RTL, the supplied current time 14:00–16:00 is visibly rendered as 16:00–14:00. The native label retains the source string, so native semantic text alone conceals the visual reordering.

evidence.observed: Unidentified time Text label is 14:00–16:00 while Local direction is Rtl.

findings.causeHypothesis: VisitText inherits paragraph direction for a numeric display-ready time without directional isolation.

findings.description: Unavailable rows are not exposed as disabled native targets: visit.slot.s10 and visit.slot.w11 have enabled=true and native role Other. The s10 tap is attempted as enabled and emits no callback. Callback suppression is correct, but native disabled state is wrong.

evidence.observed: s10 enabled=true, role_raw=1; step0 outcome tapped with empty callback_delta.
w11 enabled=true despite unavailable availability in supplied model.

findings.causeHypothesis: accessibilityElement(children: .ignore) after disabled creates an accessible wrapper rather than preserving the disabled Button semantics.

findings.description: Disabled rows and confirmation buttons are additionally dimmed, violating full-opacity disabled row treatment and the specified disabled palette. Light unavailable row text is pale and low contrast; dark disabled confirm text is also dimmed beyond the intended readable secondary color.

evidence.observed: Unavailable row is visibly washed out relative to the independent reference.

Light unavailable fill dominant RGB250,251,252 versus specified244,246,249; row text interior dominant166,174,184 versus specified82,97,116. Light disabled confirm fill241,243,245 versus228,231,236 and text171,177,189 versus102,112,133. Dark disabled confirm fill37,46,62 versus52,64,84 and text111,121,137 versus184,196,212.
The same faded treatment affects w11 detail and long unavailable reason.

findings.causeHypothesis: PlainButtonStyle applies native disabled dimming to the already styled disabled label and its background. Pixel observations are composited appearance, not raw native style attributes.

findings.description: Fee consent has a native semantic frame only36.67pt high and switch leaf28pt high, below44pt. The outer source frame(minHeight:44) does not appear in the exposed control frame. Actual physical hit area outside that frame was not tested, so a touch-target failure is suspected rather than confirmed.

evidence.observed: visit.fee_consent frame width256 height36.666656; activation leaf width63 height28. Tap succeeds on the leaf.

findings.causeHypothesis: The minHeight modifier expands an outer layout wrapper while native Toggle semantic/hit geometry remains intrinsic.

supportedObservations: Supplied Android traces show select_slot:f09 once, no repeat callback on selected row, no unavailable-row/disabled-confirm callback, confirm:f09 once; fee-on/confirm:e17/free-row selection behave as expected.
Supplied iOS physical tap traces have corresponding callbacks and selected row native state. Unavailable tap suppresses callback despite incorrect enabled accessibility state.
All twelve platform/case coverage records report bottom_reached=true. Large-font scroll screenshots show wrapping supplied text and reachable final actions.
Loading, unavailable and confirmed screenshots and observed identifiers omit stale chooser content. Retry and Done each emit one expected callback in both supplied platform traces.

remainingUnassessedAreas.description: Initial inputs contain no invalid/unavailable selectedSlotId case or whole-model replacement action. Those R04/R06/R09 branches remain source-reviewed rather than runtime-proven.
Fee-off callback and rapid caller-update sequences are not exercised in supplied inputs; fee-on and free selection only are observed.
Android action records use semantic OnClick invocation and ScrollState displacement, not physical Android touch/OS gestures. Native physical touch and Activity lifecycle are unassessed.
SwiftUI native raw font/color/padding properties are unavailable. Screenshot pixel values represent composited output only; unavailable attributes are not marked passed.
Native accessibility frames do not by themselves establish all physical hit boundaries, particularly IOS-003.
The supplied font case reaches1.8 Android/accessibility Apple equivalent; universal2.0 behavior and unprovided long amount/content variants are unassessed.
Android observation overflow=true appears on many normal unellipsized Text nodes; this was not treated as clipping without matching visual evidence.
